properties.displayName: [Preview]: Assess workload readiness for continuity on Azure Local
properties.description: Assess whether the Azure resource types used by a workload are supported on connected Azure Local to help determine continuity readiness if Azure Public access is disrupted. Use Audit to report unsupported resource types, Deny to prevent their creation, or Disabled to turn off the assessment.

metadata.description: Controls the assessment of the workload against connected Azure Local. Use Audit to report unsupported resource types, Deny to prevent their creation, or Disabled to turn off the assessment.
